rationale: The parties have clarified their red lines and there is partial alignment on the need for restructuring, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labor and the state reject closures and forced layoffs, while management and investors still insist on material capacity reduction if savings are insufficient. Positions are not yet fully hardened into a final impasse because several actors are still open to quantified alternatives, so another round could still test whether a numbers-based compromise is possible.
